title: Hinomori Shiho — Chatting With The Band〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, this still doesn't sound right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess you can only ask so much from a smartphone app. It isn't very good at combining sounds.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hi, Shiho. I was wondering who was in here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're here very early. Were you practicing by yourself...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, you could call it that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to be doing just fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Remember how those black fragments made you all see that dream? We were wondering if there were any lingering aftereffects that we should worry about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for the concern.
But I am doing just fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is Shiho we're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure if this counts as an aftereffect, but that dream did compel me to try something.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I have the sound file here. Would you mind giving it a listen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's one of Leo/need's songs.
Wait, am I hearing two basses?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. I tried combining the recording of our practice the other day with another recording of me playing my bass.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I sorta just smashed them together, so the end result doesn't sound very good.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, I understand...
I see what you were trying to do, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. Your goal was to get the keyboard and guitar to sound brighter by adding more bass, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's incredible. You got all that after listening for only a few seconds?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If anything, you're what's most incredible, Shiho. You got your message across so easily.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because STANDOUT had two in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mio played the main bassline, while I spiced things up by throwing in whatever I could.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If I can figure this out, then it won't just give our keyboard and guitar a boost. It should also do the same for our vocals, and really help us expand our horizons.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You care so much about Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because we clearly wanted to be with each other regardless of where we were or what we were doing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think that's ever going to change for us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Also, I'm impressed by your drive.
It's amazing how you're trying to put what you experienced during that dream into practice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But my little experiment isn't really working.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess it just means that Leo/need shouldn't have two bassists. Especially since we'd have to find another one...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'll be your second bassist.
Why don't we try playing that song together?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, since the others won't be here for a little while...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That sounds fun. Why don't I take the drums?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, let's give it a try.
I'll count us in.
